description: Check a company or person name against the U.S. Consolidated Screening List (Commerce, State and Treasury: OFAC SDN, BIS Entity List and others), refreshed daily. Returns possible matches with their source list and match strength. A match is not a legal determination, and no match does not mean the party is cleared.
